reviews.title: It works for me without issues
reviews.comment: It's been 6 months since I installed this power supply on a computer that is always in and I'm pretty rough with. With a product like this you want to install it and forget about it. I literally forgot I swapped out power supplies until today. No issues, no problems, nothing to remind me. Computer just works and supports my new graphics card.
reviews.author: Jonathan Sumner
